speaker: Manmohan Singh
venue: Red Fort, New Delhi (Independence Day address)
quote_english: In the last 8 years, we have doubled the support prices of crops.
summary: The Prime Minister said support prices had doubled in eight years; CACP-fixed MSP data show paddy (common) rising from about Rs 560/quintal in 2004-05 to Rs 1,250 in 2012-13 and wheat from about Rs 640 to Rs 1,350 over the same period.

transcript_sources.title: Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh's Independence Day Speech, 2012 (official English rendering)

evidence.key_figure: Paddy (common) MSP Rs 645 (2007-08) rising to Rs 1,250 (2012-13); wheat MSP Rs 1,000 (2007-08) rising to Rs 1,350 (2012-13)

evidence.title: Minimum Support Price for Foodgrains according to crop year
evidence.key_figure: Historical MSP series for paddy (common), wheat and other crops by crop year

analysis:
The 2012 Independence Day address stated that crop support prices had doubled over the previous eight years. CACP-fixed MSP data for the two main cereals support the direction and roughly the size of the increase.

Paddy (common) MSP was Rs 560 per quintal in 2004-05 and rose to Rs 1,250 in 2012-13; wheat MSP was Rs 640 per quintal in 2004-05 and rose to Rs 1,350 in 2012-13. Both more than doubled across the period.

MSP is announced by the central government on CACP recommendations and applies to 22-plus crops, with wide differences across crops and years. The claim is consistent with the official MSP series for the major cereals.
notes: The 2004-05 MSP base values (Rs 560 paddy common, Rs 640 wheat) are widely cited and appear in the RBI MSP series; the RBI/Maharashtra tables seen in search results cover 2007-08 onwards in the excerpts shown, so the 2004-05 base is given as reported. Quote is from the official English rendering (speech delivered in Hindi).
